about: Hand-made answers for scripts/coop-build.mjs, which matches a game of the host (data/coop-host-games.json) to its Steam page. Key = the host's slug. Value = the Steam app number (the number in store.steampowered.com/app/<number>/) when the automatic name match is wrong or empty, or {"skip": "reason"} when the game must not get a page and posts. The program lists every game it could not match, with the names Steam offered, in data/coop-build-report.md: put the answers here. A number written here always wins.

grand_theft_auto_5.skip: servers for this game are modded role-play servers (FiveM), not the game's own multiplayer

red_dead_redemption_2.skip: servers for this game are modded role-play servers (RedM), not the game's own multiplayer

minecraft.skip: not on Steam: no Steam facts and no cover we may use (add a hand-made block in data/coop-games.json to include it)

hytale.skip: not on Steam: no Steam facts and no cover we may use

skyrim_together.skip: a mod, not a game on Steam

conan_exiles.skip: the same Steam page as conan_exiles_enhanced (Steam renamed the game): one page is enough

counter_strike_global_offensive.skip: the same Steam page as counter_strike_2 (Steam renamed the game): one page is enough

path_of_titans.skip: no Steam page found by name; put its Steam number here if it has one
